Message: RPi5VacuumIO rev A.1 board on a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (PiModel 4B) or Raspberry Pi 5 (PiModel 5).
groupName: equipment sharing a groupName is one cascade stage, energized together; every member must be ready
before the next groupName starts. Order = first appearance. The first groupName holds only MechanicalVacuumPump.
Channels: logical A outputs -> relays K1..K8; logical B ready inputs -> opto inputs DI1..DI16.
Faults: optional 'healthy = ON' inputs per B channel. An open fault input stops that pump and the cascade.
Gauges: AI input and conversion law. log: p = 10^(Slope*U + Offset); linear: p = Slope*U + Offset.

A pump turns ready (green) only when its ready input is on AND its gauge reads p <= value (an exact match or lower). Set "Interlock": false on a gauge to use the ready input alone (WIRING.md jumper test).
Serial: Pi 4B -> RS485 /dev/ttyAMA0 (needs dtoverlay=disable-bt), RS232 on uart5 (dtoverlay=uart5, check ls -l /dev/ttyAMA*).
Enable: CONFIGURATION / GENERAL / Active vacuum control edits this entry.
true -> activate vacuum control in the mode selected by scan IsProduction.
false -> disable vacuum control and bypass its scan-readiness gate.
Read at service start: Configuration Update resets the controller after changing it.
Scan IsProduction selects hardware (true) or emulation (false). Enable controls activation; IsProduction below is the fallback for standalone use.
